module: Manages the drag settings files (*.dragSettings.json) in the drag race editor. A settings entry describes a race: id, stripId, dragType (headsUpRace/bracketRace), context (freeroam/activity), phases (stage, countdown, race, stop), timers and prefabs (starting tree, display board, paths, decorations). The module keeps in memory a single dragSettings object (the displayed settings) and the list of files found, lists, loads, creates, renames and saves these files, and draws the corresponding ImGui panels.
notes: loadAllSettings searches in /levels/<level>/dragstrips/*.dragSettings.json then in /gameplay/missions/<level>/dragStripRace/*/dragSettings.json and dragStripAPM/*/dragSettings.json. It tries the level name as is, in lowercase, with spaces replaced by "_", and both.
A file in the list is {type, path, name, _dirty, _fileExists?, _cachedData?}. The type is level, dragStripRace, dragStripAPM (or mission via the Add button).
Only the current dragSettings object is editable: changing the selection caches (_cachedData) the modified unsaved settings and reloads the other one from disk.
facilityId is added in memory by facilities.selectFacility but removed on load and on save (never written to the file).
Save: validation (dragType and stripId non-empty), then if the file is in the level's dragstrips folder and id has changed, the file is renamed to <id>.dragSettings.json (fails if that name exists).
On read, if timers is missing or empty, dragSaveSystem.DEFAULT_TIMERS is used.
In loadAllSettings, the loop that resets _dirty to false runs on a list that has just been emptied (no effect).

loadAllSettings.desc: Empties the list then fills it with the settings files of the current level and its dragStripRace / dragStripAPM missions. The displayed name is json.id if it exists, otherwise the file or folder name. Does nothing without a loaded level.

getAllSettings.desc: Returns the list of settings files.

getSelectedSettingsIndex.desc: Index (1-based) of the selected file, -1 if none.

setSelectedSettingsIndex.desc: Sets the selected index without loading data.

selectSettings.desc: Selects a file: caches the previous settings if modified, deselects the strip, then restores the cache, or loads the file from disk, or for a nonexistent file takes the name as id.

drawSettingsList.desc: Draws the "Drag Settings" section (list, Add button via save dialog, etc.). The buttons are disabled if there is no saved strip.

drawSettingsDetails.desc: Draws the detail of the selected settings: Basics, Phases, Timers, Prefabs. Modifications call markDirty.

getDragSettings.desc: Returns the dragSettings object being edited.

setDragSettings.desc: Replaces the current dragSettings object (unchanged if nil).

markDirty.desc: Marks the selected file as modified and copies dragSettings into its cache.

loadDragSettings.desc: Reads a JSON file into dragSettings, removes facilityId, fills in id (file name) and default timers, and resets _dirty to false for the corresponding file.

returns.desc: false and error displayed if reading fails

saveDragSettings.desc: Validates then writes dragSettings (without facilityId) as JSON. Fixes the extension to .dragSettings.json, removes the characters *?<>|", renames the file if the id changed (level folder), creates the folder if needed and updates the selected entry.

filePath.desc: target path; path of the selected entry if nil

validateDragSettings.desc: Checks that a settings entry has a non-empty dragType and stripId.

drawDragSettingsSection.desc: Draws an ImGui "Drag Settings" panel (old presentation in a fixed 200 px high block).

drawPrefabsSection.desc: Draws the prefab editing (tree, board, paths, decorations).
